scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const root=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..','..');const target=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'dist');if(target!==path.join(root,'apps','server','dist'))throw Error('Unsafe build output path');fs.rmSync(target,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/test/*.test.js dist/rehearsal/*.test.js dist/discord/*.test.js "dist/admin/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:db: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/rehearsal/store.db.test.js dist/discord/session.db.test.js "dist/admin/**/*.db.test.js"
scripts.db:setup: npm run build && node dist/rehearsal/cli.js setup
scripts.rehearse: npm run build && node dist/rehearsal/cli.js rehearse
scripts.db:discord-setup: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js setup
scripts.discord:prepare: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js prepare
scripts.discord:register: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js register
scripts.discord:run: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js run
scripts.discord:signup-prepare: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js signup-prepare
scripts.discord:signup-register: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js signup-register
scripts.discord:signup-run: npm run build && node dist/discord/runtime.js signup-run
